environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a self-hosted Snowstorm instance (e.g. https://my-snowstorm.example.com/snowstorm/snomed-ct). Required only when ENABLE_SNOMED_TOOLS is true.

environmentVariables.description: Accept-Language tag(s) for SNOMED responses (e.g. pt, pt-BR, es). Optional; defaults to 'en'. Composite values with q-weights depend on the upstream Snowstorm instance.
environmentVariables.name: SNOMED_LANGUAGE

environmentVariables.description: pino log level (debug, info, warn, error, fatal). Optional; defaults to 'info'. Logs go to stderr only — never stdout (which is the MCP stdio transport).
environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
